body.intent: The daemon's stall detection covers every agent session of any workflow's run, including the children a conductor spawns: an idle child with no done mark (the fixer that held a run 9 hours on 2026-11-16) is nudged, then its step retried or failed with a reason, replacing the check-in alarms of the withdrawn draft 01M7M2FE1S and the orchestrator's runwatch
